The bigger worry is giving opponents access to more houses: p1 and p4 are too cash-poor to build, but p2, sitting on $501 and holding a green monopoly with no houses yet, could easily grab houses from the newly expanded supply. That makes me lean toward holding onto cash and keeping houses scarce rather than rushing the hotel upgrade right now.
